parallels.note: “ ‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.

people.name: Great_Sea
people.line: The Mediterranean Sea, the western boundary of the Promised Land.

people.name: Hamath
people.line: A major city and kingdom in Syria, often mentioned in the Bible.

people.name: Hethlon
people.line: Place on the northern border of Israel

people.name: Zedad
people.line: A place on the northern border of the Promised Land

translations.web: “This shall be the border of the land: “On the north side, from the great sea, by the way of Hethlon, to the entrance of Zedad;
translations.bsb: This shall be the boundary of the land: On the north side it will extend from the Great Sea by way of Hethlon through Lebo-hamath to Zedad,
translations.kjv: And this shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;
translations.asv: And this shall be the border of the land: On the north side, from the great sea, by the way of Hethlon, unto the entrance of Zedad;
